description: SI tools assisted code, tests, documentation, integration and review. Provider observations and model products were not generated by these tools. Derived results are calculated by SI-assisted software; scientific validation remains the team's responsibility.

tools.name: Anthropic Claude Code
tools.use: Assisted backend and UI implementation, statistical workflows, station views and synthetic software tests; team submissions and decisions are retained.

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.use: Assisted repository integration, UI/backend connections, mechanical fixes, tests, documentation, review, disclosure metadata and user-authorized local data retrieval. No new scientific method was implemented by the disclosure task.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.use: Assisted Nikola's accepted experimental historical-flow assessment submission. The separate UI continuation branch is excluded.

data.origin: Provider-supplied CAMELS-CH, NVE/seNorge and GLDAS observations, gridded products and model output; provider-supplied map geometry and imagery.
data.processing: SI-assisted code performs parsing, interpolation, aggregation, statistical analysis, historical scenario calculations and plotting. Preserve provider provenance, units, quality information and local interpolation flags.
data.test_fixtures: Synthetic test fixtures are invented software-test data produced with SI assistance. They are not observations or scientific validation and are not a substitute for missing application data.

logo.origin: Hand-made team artwork, supplied by the user as Drawing-3.sketchpad.webp
logo.transformation: Copied byte-for-byte; rendered at existing logo sizes. No generative editing or tracing.

media.charts: Deterministic visualizations of saved data rendered by SI-assisted code, not generatively fabricated scenes or measurements.

requirements.generated_images_and_video: Any future SI-generated images or videos must carry a visible SI-generation watermark.
requirements.generated_audio: Any future SI-generated audio must acknowledge generation in descriptive text and file metadata.
requirements.code_and_data: Acknowledge SI assistance in descriptive text and machine-readable metadata; distinguish software assistance from generated observations.
requirements.branding: Do not use, contain or modify NASA logos, flags, mission emblems or protected visual identifiers in SI-generated content. Preserve factual scientific source attribution without implying endorsement.

csv_fields._si_code_assistance: SI-assisted code; provider data, not SI-generated observations
csv_fields._si_project_tools: Anthropic Claude Code; OpenAI Codex; Perplexity

model_version_note: Exact assistant model versions were not independently recorded; no version is inferred from product names.
